final_message: Fixed the off-by-one in `compound` (`src/ledger/interest.py:27`): the loop ran `years - 1` times instead of `years`, so each compounding period was skipped once. Changed it to `range(years)` and added `test_compound_for_two_years_applies_interest_twice`, which checks that 1000.00 at 5% for 2 years now correctly yields 1102.50. Full suite: **67 passed**.
